title: Good support app. Even with free version!
body:
Task management with a friendly face!
As someone who is newly diagnosed I’m finding this a good fit.
author: This nickname is taken..agh!

title: Refund
body: Can I please be provided with a contact email to request a refund. I signed up for a 30 day free trial. It said I would be notified before the 30 days were up, I was not. I haven’t received one single email from this app, nor do I have a profile I can access. I have no means of cancelling or contacting.
author: CSwee79

title: Terrible app
body: The app is terrible, they charge extortionate prices and the customer service is just as bad. I would recommend anyone to keep well away from this awful app
author: OisínMcMen

title: App takes payments after trial cancelled
body: App has been taken payments for 4 months despite cancelling during free trial. I received no communication after contacting company. Still trying to get a refund.
author: tropbiz

title: Malicious Extortion
body:
A common ADHD trait is spending without thinking. This app is charging €18.49 a month which is DAYLIGHT ROBBERY. 

There is plenty of free support and tool apps and sites out there that will do the same for free.

Do not burn your money using this app.

Developers of the app you should be ashamed
author: Duff790
